evals.name: explicit-interview-me-trigger
evals.prompt: Interview me before you build this — I want the dashboard redesign spec locked down first.
evals.expected_output: Triggers intent-lock. Reads the active checks from the Misread Ledger first. Round 1 is one picker call with at most 3 questions that settle kind of output, use, and depth and breadth; each option describes a concrete output. No narration of steps, no draft reading, no checklist is printed.

evals.name: round-cap-then-work
evals.prompt: Lock the goal before we start: I need a migration script from the old schema to the new one.
evals.expected_output: Triggers intent-lock. Asks at most 3 rounds, then writes the lock and starts work in the same turn without asking permission. Slots still open after the last round are stated as assumptions in the lock lines.

evals.name: thai-trigger
evals.prompt: ล็อคเป้าหมายก่อนนะ ผมอยากได้ระบบแจ้งเตือนสำหรับแอปคลินิก
evals.expected_output: Triggers on ล็อคเป้าหมาย. Questions and lock lines are in Thai with technical terms in English.

evals.name: unprompted-expensive-ambiguous-request
evals.prompt: Build me the full reporting pipeline — pull from all our data sources, clean it, and generate the exec summary however makes sense.
evals.expected_output: No trigger phrase. The request is expensive, reusable and ambiguous, so the skill opens the interview before building. Does not build a guessed pipeline.

evals.name: lock-lines-and-check
evals.prompt: Ask me until you understand exactly what I want for this onboarding email sequence — don't guess.
evals.expected_output: After the interview the output opens with 3 to 5 lock lines written as plain sentences with no lead-in labels: the locked goal with kind, use and depth, the assumptions if any, and the result of the comparison between the work and the lock. Never proposes a bigger or better sequence than asked. Never emits a prompt or spec for use elsewhere.

evals.name: drift-is-fixed-and-logged
evals.prompt: Interview me, then write a whole-disorder review of intermittent explosive disorder.
evals.expected_output: If the draft is treatment-heavy or treatment-only, the check before delivery finds the drift against the locked kind (whole-disorder review), fixes it, reports the fix in the lock lines, and writes one drift entry to the Misread Ledger in a single write.

evals.name: unattended-run-asks-nothing
evals.prompt: [scheduled run] Write this week's comprehensive review of the top watchlist topic.
evals.expected_output: Nobody can answer a picker. The skill asks nothing, fills every slot with its default, and states each unconfirmed default as an assumption in the lock lines. FAILS if a picker is opened.

evals.name: negative-precise-one-line-request
evals.prompt: Rename the variable `usrId` to `userId` in src/auth.ts.
evals.expected_output: Does NOT trigger intent-lock. The request has one reading and a wrong reading costs almost nothing. FAILS if an interview, picker or ledger read is started.

evals.name: negative-post-delivery-complaint-routes-to-misread-capture
evals.prompt: You wasted my time — that's not even close to what I asked for.
evals.expected_output: Does NOT trigger intent-lock. This is a correction of delivered work, so misread-capture handles it. FAILS if an intent-lock interview is opened.
